title: Raspberry Pi autofocus cannot complete with one request per exposure
summary: RPI_AF only queues AfModeAuto/AfTriggerStart for the next exposure; each exposure restarts the camera with a single request, so the scan cannot complete, RPI_AF reports OK immediately and the AF lens position is not read back. An abort or frame timeout also drops a pending trigger. Next: design streaming AF with AfState/LensPosition metadata and test on an autofocus camera (e.g. Camera Module 3).
